create_apollo_env: create an ApolloEnv instance with an XML path and config for a simulated Apollo robot environment
get_apollo_assets: get a dictionary of MuJoCo XML assets for the Apollo robot from playground and menagerie directories
get_robot_sensor_data: get gravity, linear velocity, angular velocity, accelerometer, and gyroscope readings from Apollo robot sensors
check_feet_ground_contacts: check whether the left and right feet of the Apollo robot are in contact with the ground
access_apollo_model_properties: access the xml path, action size, mj_model, and mjx_model properties of an Apollo environment
